test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: What sum (in ₹) will earn a simple interest of ₹240 in 2 years at 16% per year rate of interest?
solution:
**Given:**

Simple Interest (SI) = ₹240

Time (t) = 2 years

Rate of Interest (r) = 16% per year

**Formula used:**

SI = dfrac{P × r × t}{100}

Where, P = Principal amount

**Calculation:**

240 = dfrac{P × 16 × 2}{100}

⇒ 240 = dfrac{32P}{100}

⇒ (240 × 100)/(32) = P

⇒ P = 750

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
